title: Alabama launches investigation into OpenAI’s hack of Hugging Face

thread_text:
1. Your data was exposed

OpenAI's hack of Hugging Face leaked credentials that could give attackers access to your AI accounts and personal projects.

2. Alabama is investigating

The state's Attorney General has opened a probe into the breach, signaling potential legal consequences for all parties involved.

3. Thousands may be affected

Early estimates suggest the stolen data could impact thousands of users, though the exact number remains unknown.

4. Check if you're at risk

Use Have I Been Pwned to see if your email or credentials appear in the leaked dataset.

5. Secure your accounts now

Change your passwords and enable two-factor authentication today—don't wait for someone to use your data.
